class.name: NNBTSucceeder
class.brief_description: Runs its child to completion and always returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS].
class.description: Waits while its child returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING], then completes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] whether the child succeeded or failed. Use for optional steps in an [NNBTSequence] whose failure should not abort the rest of the sequence. Unlike [NNBTFixedResult], this node does not override [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while the child is still in progress.
